title: Phone memory ceiling for 1904 lowered after texture residency
items: Nothing you can see changed. 1904 now reads 850 MB on a phone when you arrive, down from 1,106 MB, because house pictures load only near you. The check that holds it now allows 950 MB, down from 1,225 MB.
We checked four more views, including one from above Glessner House. Holding fewer pictures in memory changed fewer pixels than the swaying trees did.
